h:
我在本地生成图像时使用的简单工作流程。它包括第一代通道、通过第二通道重新缩放以细化细节以及用于良好测量的面部细节器。

它应该适用于 ANIMA 以外的模型，但这需要对节点和参数进行一些调整。

V3 利用 ComfyUI 子图来保持一切整洁。

V2 没有

两者的工作方式相同，产生相同的质量并具有相同的速度。

o.en:
A simple workflow I use when generating images locally. It includes a first genration pass, a rescale with second pass to refine details and a Face Detailer for good measure.

It should work for models other than ANIMA, but that would require some tweaking of nodes and parameters.

V3 Leverages on ComfyUI subgraphs to keep everything neat.

V2 Doesn't

Both work the same way, generate the same quality and have the same speed.
